method: Union of the two blocks after the original observation mapping. Compute each folded phase once per physical proposal and rule. Stream original per-block quadrature hashes, then restore observer order and use the original finite-resolution and sampler decision gates.
scope: Circular detached, unspotted reflected blackbody with linear limb darkening. Two reflection iterations, 18 input phases and 28 observations in B, V and bolometric light at nominal sigma 1e-4. Observations generated with the original 12-degree facet model. Inner branch of the Roche surface; original physical domain and unsupported-case semantics.
timing_boundary: One sequential execution per configuration. Start at restoration of sixteen previously qualified checkpoints and finish at durable decisions and host-pool exit. GPU owner time includes launch, probe, compilation, physics, transfers, archive writes and hold verification. Independent audits follow the timed runs.
